payload.title: Residual sequence-state evidence beyond E011
payload.statement: Legal within-well row-sequence and typewell-consistency features may predict a bounded higher-resolution residual profile around E011 that transfers across repeated whole-well, spatial, and typewell holdouts.
payload.evidence_for: E010 proves a 4.7511 legal path-bank oracle and E011 remains at 12.5508. E011 residuals retain trend and shape error, while T022 rules out the existing well-level uncertainty feature space rather than row-sequence evidence.
payload.evidence_against: E010 legal selection, E012 specialists, and T022 routing all fail. Sequence models can overfit autocorrelated GR, repeated motifs, boundary artifacts, or target-profile smoothness.
payload.next_test: Complete the frozen T023 screen: residual autocorrelation and spline-oracle capacity; twelve legal or negative-control sequence branches over 25 repeated contexts; stress validation for every preliminary passer; exact reproduction and edge tests.
